wizard.title: Create AI Employee
wizard.subtitle: Let's set up your new AI team member. Answer a few questions and we'll configure everything for you.
wizard.q1Name: What should this AI employee be called? Give it a name that fits your brand — like "Maya" or "Support Bot".
wizard.q2Responsibility: What should this AI employee be responsible for? For example: answering customer questions, handling returns, booking appointments, qualifying leads...
wizard.q3Channels: Where should it interact with customers? For example: WhatsApp, Instagram, Email, Webchat — you can pick multiple.
wizard.q4Communication: How should it communicate? Describe the tone and style — professional, friendly, casual, empathetic? Should it use emojis? Keep replies short or detailed?
wizard.q5Escalation: When should it involve a human agent? For example: when a customer is angry, asks a complex question, requests a refund, or explicitly asks for a person.
wizard.q6AiDisclosure: Should customers know they're talking to AI? Should the bot introduce itself as AI, or behave as a regular team member?
wizard.q7Extra: Any special instructions or knowledge it should have? For example: specific company policies, product details, things it should never say, or FAQ topics.
wizard.q8ConversationFlow: What steps should the AI follow when talking to customers? For example: greet, ask for order number, look up order, provide status, ask if anything else is needed.
wizard.q9Guardrails: Are there any specific business rules it must always follow? For example: never offer more than 10% discount, always verify identity before sharing account details, never discuss competitor pricing.
